test_cases.prompt: How does the document processing pipeline work in RAG-Anything? Walk me through the full flow from file input to stored entities.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should describe the pipeline: Parser selection -> Content List generation -> separate_content() -> text insertion via LightRAG.ainsert() -> multimodal processing via modal processors -> entity extraction -> storage in KG and vector DBs. Should reference specific files: processor.py, parser.py, utils.py, modalprocessors.py.
assertions: Mentions Parser base class and the 3 implementations (MinerU, Docling, PaddleOCR)
Describes content list format with type/text/image/table/equation blocks
Explains separate_content() splitting text from multimodal items
References LightRAG storage components (chunks_vdb, entities_vdb, knowledge graph)
Provides specific file paths and line references

test_cases.prompt: My parsed documents are returning stale results even after I update the source PDF. How do I debug this?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should identify the parse caching system in processor.py, explain cache key generation (file path + mtime + parser config), suggest checking cache invalidation, and show how to clear or bypass the cache.
assertions: Identifies parse_cache KV storage namespace in processor.py
Explains cache key includes file modification time
Suggests cache may not be invalidating due to config or mtime issues
References _get_cached_result() and _store_cached_result() methods

test_cases.prompt: How do I configure RAG-Anything to use Ollama for LLM and OpenAI for embeddings?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should explain RAGAnythingConfig and lightrag_kwargs, reference env.example for environment variables, and show how to set LLM_BINDING=ollama with EMBEDDING_BINDING=openai.
assertions: References config.py RAGAnythingConfig
Mentions environment variable overrides
Shows LLM_BINDING and EMBEDDING_BINDING configuration
References env.example for full config reference

test_cases.expected_behavior: Should scaffold a TesseractParser class extending Parser, implementing parse_pdf(), parse_image(), parse_document(), and check_installation(). Should register in SUPPORTED_PARSERS and get_parser(). Should follow security practices for path validation.
assertions: Creates TesseractParser class extending Parser
Implements all 4 abstract methods with correct signatures
Returns content list in standard format (type/text/img_path fields)
Registers in SUPPORTED_PARSERS tuple and get_parser() factory
Uses _unique_output_dir() for output directory creation
Validates paths against directory traversal
